# Messages

> Cross-server messaging over MessagingService with JSON payloads.

- Package: `Messages` · Category: Data & players
- Starts at server boot: only when picked; otherwise the first time game code uses it
- Installing it also installs: nothing else (only Core)
- Check it is installed: `GaxiaServer.IsInstalled("Messages")` (server) / `Gaxia.IsInstalled("Messages")` (shared/client keys)

## `GaxiaServer.Messages`

- Runs: **server only (Script / server ModuleScript)**
- Source: `src/ServerStorage/Gaxia_Packages_Server/Lib/CrossServerMessaging.lua`

Get it:

```lua
local GaxiaServer = require(game:GetService("ServerStorage").Gaxia_Packages_Server)
local Messages = GaxiaServer.Messages
```

### Functions

- `Messages.Subscribe(topic: string, handler: (data: any, sentTimestamp: number) -> ()): RBXScriptConnection`
- `Messages.Publish(topic: string, data: any): boolean`

### Signals

Connect with `:Connect(function(...) end)`; the parameters are the payload types, in order.

- `Messages.OnError` — `Signal<string, string>`
  (topic, reason) when a publish is dropped / fails or a received message cannot be handled
